title: Report Repair
description: Find two and three numbers in an expense report that sum to 2020.
writeup:
## Approach

Use a set for O(1) complement lookups.

## Part 1

For each number `n`, check if `2020 - n` exists in the set. Return the product of the matching pair.

## Part 2

Iterate over all pairs `(a, b)` and check if `2020 - a - b` exists in the set. Return the product of the matching triple.
